newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan paper makers' profits seen suffering - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan paper makers' profits seen suffering - paper.

text.p: Parent current profit at major paper and pulp makers are expected to suffer in the year to next March 31 from sluggish domestic demand and the yen's weaker trend, a Japanese newspaper said on Friday.

Economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said New Oji Paper Co Ltd's 1996/97 parent current profit would be only 51 billion yen even though the company plans to merge with Honshu Paper Co Ltd in October. New Oji's parent current profit was 48.07 billion yen in 1995/96. Current profit at Nippon Paper Industries Co Ltd and Daio Paper Corp are expected to fall as well, the paper said.
